edit.description: read the required- and optional-field lists off DeclarationSchema.shape instead of keeping them by hand

summary: Derive harnessDeclaration's required/optional field lists off the schema — the two hand-kept lists partition 12 of 13 fields, leaving handoff unexercised

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: Both field-list cases read their lists off DeclarationSchema.shape; every one of the schema's fields is exercised as required or as optional, handoff included.
pins: the required and optional field cases together name every field the declaration schema declares
a declaration omitting its handoff parses, and handoff reads undefined
notes: Measured: shape has 13 keys; the hand list at the required case names 4, the optional case names 8, and handoff is in neither, so nothing proves it optional. Deriving required as the keys that refuse `undefined` reproduces both lists exactly and adds handoff.
